Take almonde mylke as i con preche; coloure hit with safron as i e teche; fors hit with poudur, at
is gode; take larde of porke, wele so yn, by o rode; hew hit in gobettes wele afyne; loke ey ben
smale and put hem inne; <<13>> lye hit with floure or amydone, boyle hit wele and sett hit done;
florysshe hit with powdur, as i e kenne, enne may hit be served, before gode men. Rose. Take flour
of ryse, as whyte as sylke, and hit welle, with almond mylke; boyle hit tyl hit be chargyd, enne
take braune of capone or elle of henne; loke ou grynd hit wondur smalle, and sithen ou charge hit
with alle; coloure with alkenet, sawnder, or ellys with blode, fors hit with clowes or macys gode;
seson hit with sugur grete plent , is is a rose, as kokes telle me. Lede lardes [leche lardes]. Take
eyren and swete mylke of a cow, swyng hom togedur, as i byd now; take larde of fresshe porke with
alle, sethe hit and schere hit on peses smalle; cast er in and boyle hit, enne styr hit wele, as i e
kenne, tyl hit be gedered on crud harde; leche hit, and rost hit afterwarde apone a gredel, en serve
ou may hit forthe, with spit, as i e say. For blanchyd mortrews. Sethe hennes and porke, at is fulle
fresshe; bray almondes unblanchyd and temper hom nesshe with clene brothe, and drawe hom o; <<14>>
alay y flesshe smalle grounden to, and floure of ryce ou grynd also; cast powder of gyngere and
sugur erinne, but loke at hit be not to yn, but stondand and saltid mesurl and kepe y dysshe mete
for o maystr . Peions istued. Take peions and hew hom in morselle smalle, put hom in a er yn pot, ou
shalle; take pilled garlek and herbys anon, hack hom smalle er ou more don; put hom in o pot, and er
to take gode brothe with wyte grece, ou no 3 t forsake; do powdur er to and gode verius, coloure hit
with safron, and salt inow; ou put in pote ese ynges alle, and stue y peions us ou schalle. Sowpus
dorre. Take almondes, bray hem, wryng hom up; boyle hom with wyn rede to sup; en temper hom with
wyn, salt, i rede, and loke ou tost fyne wete brede, and lay in dysshes, dubene with wyne; do in is
dysshes mete, at is so fyne; messe hit forthe, and florysshe hit enne with sugur and gynger, as i e
kenne. Gruel of almondes. Take almondes unblanchid and bray hom sone, put ote mele to, enne hase ou
done, and grynde alle sammen, and draw hit enne with water and sethe, as i e kenne; <<15>> coloure
hit with safron and salt hit enne, and set in sale byfore gode menne. Ioutus de almonde. Take erbe,
perboyle hom, fayre and wele; hew hom and grynde hom every dele; take almondes unblanched and grynd
hom smalle, draw 3 e hom with water, i wote ou schalle; set hit over e fyre, yn erbis ou sethe with
o mylke forsayde, at grounden is smethe; cast erto sugur, and salt anone; take er y ioutes made
dalmone. Caudel dalmone. Take almondes unblanchyd and hom ou bray; drawe hom up with wyn, i dar wele
say; er to do pouder of good gyngere and sugur, and boyle alle ese in fere, and coloure hit with
safron and salt hit wele, and serve hit forthe sir at o mele. Buttur of almonde mylke. Take thykke
mylke of almondes clere, boyle wele alle in fere; and in o boylyng, cast erinne venegur, o er ellys
gode wyne; do hit so enne in a canvas enne, in so un, gar hit on hepe to renne; in clothe ou henge
hit a myle way, and after in colde water ou hit lay; serve hit forthe in e dysshe, at day o lorde is
servyd with fysshe. <<16>> ryse. Take ryse and wasshe and grynde hem smalle, temper hom with almonde
mylke ou schalle; drau 3 e hom thorowghe a streynour clene, boyle hom and seson hom with sugur
schene; fors hit with fryude almondes gode, en hase ou done, syr, by o rode. Kaudel ferry. Take
almondes unblanchyd, so have ou cele, and wasshe hom fayre and grynd hom wele; temper hom up with
wyne so clene, and drau 3 e hom orowgh a canvas shene; in pot ou coloure hit with safron, and lye
hit up with amydone, or with floure of ryse so fre; ry 3 t thykke loke ou at be; seson hit with
sugur grete plent , florysshe hit with maces, i tel e. For to make a rape. Take raysyns of corauns
erto, and wyte wynne ou take also; sethe enne o er raysyns grete in rede wyne, and boyle a lytul
with hete; do opon a broche, rost hom bydene a lytel, and take hom fayre and clene and bray hom in a
morter smalle, a crust of brede ou bray with alle. Put alle in e pot with grythe, o raysyns of
corauns, o swete wyne with, a lytul vengur, and pouder take o of clowes, maces and quibibis to;
<<17>> boyle alle to geder, and serve hit enne, and sett hit forthe before goode men. Mylke rostyd.
Take swete mylke and put in panne, swyng eyren with alle, grynde safron and do erto; welle hit enne,
tylle hit wax thykke, as i e kenne; and sethe and sye hit thorowghe a cloth, presse hit, at leves,
withouten othe; when hit is colde, leche hit with knyves; rost hit, and messe hit forthe on schyves.
For to make a potage of welkes. Take welkes and wasshe fayre, in blythe, in water, and take whyte
salt erwith and after hakke hom on a borde, as smalle as ou may, at a worde, and bray hom in a
morter clere; sethe hom in mylke over e fyre; of almondes or of a clow ou take schalle, lye hit with
amydone erwith alle; coloure hit with safrone, and do erinne poudur of peper, or goode comyne. For
to make potage of oysturs. Perboyle yn oysturs and take hom oute; kepe welle y bre with outen doute,
and hakke hom on a borde full smalle, and bray in a morter ou schalle; do hom in hor owne brothe for
goode, do mylke of almondes er to by e rode, and lye hit up with amydone, and frye smalle mynsud
onyone <<18>> in oyle, or sethe hom in mylke ou schalle; do powdur erto of spyces withalle, and
coloure hit enne with safron gode; hit is holden restoratyf fode. Sauge seynes. Take swynes fete and
sethe hom clene, take 3 olkes of eyren at harde bene, and sage as mykul as fall erto, gode powdur,
and temper with venegur; when ou hase so yn o fete ry 3 t welle, clovyn hom and paryd hom er tylle,
lay hom on dysshe with blythe, o sawce on e 3 olkes erwyth. For to make a compost. Take o chekyns
and hew hom for o seke, all but e hede and e legges eke; take a handfulle of herb lovache, and ano
er of persely, als of sage at never was founde fals, and no er of lekes and alle hom wasshe ose
herbes in water, at rennes so rasshe; breke orowghe y honde, bothe herbe and leke, with a pynt of
hony enbeny hom eke, summe of ese herbes ou shalle laye in e pottus bothun [sothun?], as i e say;
summe of e chekyns ou put erto, and en of e herb 3 do to also; so of o ton so of at o er, o herb 3
on e last my dere brother; above ese herbus a lytul larde smalle myncyd, haldand togeder warde; take
powder of gynger and canel god wone, cast on ese o er thynges everychon; <<19>> be sle 3 e and powre
in water enne to myd o pot, as i the kenne; opone o bruys poure hit withinne, and cover hit at no
hete oute wynne, and tendurly seyth hit ou do may, salt hit, serve hit, as i e say. Blanc maungere
of fysshe. Take a pownde of ryse and sethe hom wele, tyl at ay brostene; and lete hom kele. Mylke of
almondes erto ou cast, o tenche or lampray do to on last; welle alle togeder, as i e kenne, and
messe hit forthe before godde men. Mortrews of fysshe. Take o kelkes of fysshe anon, and o lyver of
o fysshe, sethe hom alon; en take brede and peper and ale, and temper o brothe fulle welle ou
schalle, and welle hit togeder and serve hit enne, and set in sale before good mene. For to make
rose dalmoyne. Take whyte pese and wasshe hom wele, tylle at ey hulle, sethe yche adele, and bene
clene of am, en schalle ou caste in to o pot and cover in hast; and loke no brethe er passe oute,
but boyle hom wele with owtyn dowte; of almonde mylke ou kest erto, of floure of ryse and salt also;
<<20>> coloure hit with safrone and messe hit, enne set hit in sale before goode men. For a kolys. E
brawne take of sothun henne or chekyne, and hew hit smalle and bray en with wyne, with ote grotis,
and whyte brede eke; with e brothe of henne ou tempur hit meke; take oute e bonys and grynd hit
smalle, in to e brothe ou kast hit alle, and sye hit thurgh a clothe clene; dose hit, and serve hit
forthe bydene. Gruel of porke. Take brawne of swyne, perboyle hit wele, and grynde hit smalle, syr,
everydele; with 3 olkes of eyren ou schalle hit lye, set hit over e fyre for- ye, put whyte grece
erto, bewar, iwys, let hit not sethe lest ou mys. Do er to powder and safron enne and messe hit
forthe before goode menne; powder dowce eron ou kast stondande at dressore on e last. Conyngus in
cyne. [>cyve.] smyte e conyngus in pese smalle; and sethe hom in brothe gode ou shalle; mynsyn
onyons in grece ou sethe, and in good brothe, at is so smethe walle togeder; and drau 3 e alioure of
blode and brede sumdele sowre, <<21>> sesonut with venegur and good brothe eke, kast salt erto and
powder fulle meke. Harus in cyne. [>cyve.] perboyle e hare and larde hit wele, sethyn loke ou rost
hir everydele; take onyons and loke ou hew hom smalle, frye hom in grece, take peper and ale, and
grynde togeder o onyons also; coloure hit with safrone and welle hit o; lay e hare in charioure, as
i e kenne; powre on e sewe and serve hit enne. Harus in a sewe. Alle rawe o hare schalle hacked be,
in gobettis smalle, syr, levys me; in hir owne blode seyn or sylud clene, grynde brede and peper
withalle bydene; enne temper hit with e same bre, enne boyled and salted hit servyd schalle be.
Harus in abrotet. [>harus_in_a_browet.] hew smalle y hare in gobetus gode, sethe hom in brothe with
alle his blode; when hit is so un wondur wele, draw 3 h thurgh a streynour, so have ou cele; take
almondes unblanchid, wasshe hom and grynde; with self brothe temper hom by kynde; take onyons and
perboyle hom ou mot, and dresshe hom smalle, kest hom in pot with alle o er thyngus, and cast er to
with venegur and salt, en hase ou doo. <<22>> harus in perdoylyse. Take harys and perboyle hom, i
rede, in goode brothe, kele hit for drede, and hew y flesshe and cast erinne. Take swongen eggus, no
more ne myn, and cast in y sewe and sethe hit enne. Take obles and wafrons, as i e kenne, close hom
in dysshes fare and wele; salt e sewe, so have ou cele, and lay hit above as gode men done, and
messe hit forthe, syr, at o none. Hennes in brewes. With porke ou sethe o henne fatte, grynde brede
and peper and be not batte; and comyne also ou schalle grynde, seson hom with ale, at is hor kynde;
with o brothe of hennes ou temper hit shalle, boyle hit, coloure hit, salt hit withalle; serve hom
forthe, as ou may see, ese er hennes in browet, levys ou me. Chekyns in browet. Take chekyns, scalde
hom fayre and clene; take persole, sauge, o er herb 3 , grene grapus, and stope y chekyns with
wynne; take goode brothe, sethe hom erinne, so at ay sone boyled may be; coloure e brothe with
safrone fre, and cast eron powder dowce, for to be served in goode mennys howse. <<23>> chekyns in
cawdel. In brothe ou boyle y chekyns gode; take 3 olkes of eyren, syr, for o rode, alye hom up with
brothe forsayde; take powder gynger, abrayde, and sugur, and rew, and safron clere, and salt, and
set hit over o fyre; with owtyn boylyng messe hit forthe enne; y chekyns hole take, i e kenne, of
[yf?_ m ] ay be brokyn, on dysshe hom lay, helde hom e sewe, as i e say. For to boyle fesawantes and
pertryks. Take goode brothe, erin ou pyt y fesauntes and y pertryks, at men may wyt. Do erto ale,
floure, peper fre, of hole canel, good quantit ; and let alle sethe erwyth fulle wele, and messe hit
forthe, syr, at e mele. Powder dowce erin ou cast, when hit [is] servyd on e last. Roo in a sewe.
Take o roo, pyke hit clene forthy; boyle hit ou shalt and after hit drye; hew hit on gobettis, at
ben smalle, do hit in pot withalle; kest wyn erto, if ou do ry 3 t, take persole and sawge and ysope
bry 3 t, wasshe hom and hew hom wondur smalle, and do erto hit ou schalle, coloure hit with blode or
sawnders hors. <<24>> hennes in grav . Take hennes and rost, as i e kenne, sithinn, hew hom smalle
and frye hom; enne take wyne or peper or venegur to, grynd hit togeder with hennes o; lye hit with 3
olkes of eyren wele, coloure hit with safrone everydele, and messe hit forthe withoutene ony more,
and loke ou for 3 ete no 3 t ys lore. Capons in covisye. Take capons and sethe hom wele, and hew hom
smalle ilkadele; take peper and brede, and grynde hit smalle, and temper hit up with capon alle;
take why 3 te of eyren harde so un o, and hake hom smalle and do erto, and boyle e capon and coloure
hit enne with safrone, and do as i kenne; o 3 olkes of eggus, i telle e, alle hole ou put in disshe
so fre. Hennes in gauncel. Take first and rost welle y henne, take garlek by hit selfe and grynd;
enne blonde hit with mylke and put alle in panne, and hew yn henne and do er to enne y henne and 3
olkes of eyren imelle; coloure hit with safron and let hit welle, and messe hit forthe, i telle e;
but ou wille alye hit with floure so fre. <<25>> lamprayes in browet. Take lamprayes and scalde hom
by kynde, sythyn, rost hom on gredyl, and grynde peper and safrone; welle hit with alle, do o
lampreyes and serve hit in sale. Lamprayes in galentine. Take lamprayes and hom let blode at o
navel, and scalde hom for gode; rost hom enne, and ou hom laye alle hole in platere, as i e saye;
serve with galentine, made in sale, with gyngere, canel and galingale. For tenchis in grav . Sethe y
tenchis, and after hom brede, and rost hom on a gredel, i rede; grynd peper and safron with ale, i
kenne, with tenchis brothe, ou temper hit; enne lay o tenche opon a platere fayre, do on at browet
withouten disware. Chawdewyne de boyce. Take smalle notes, schale not [out?_ m ] kurnele, as ou dose
of almondes, fayre and wele; frye hom in oyle, en sethe hom ry 3 t in almonde mylke at is bry 3 t;
en ou schalle do in floure of ryce and also o er pouder of spyce; fry o er curneles besyde also,
coloure ou hit with safron, or ou fer goo, to divers o mete ou schalt hit set, with o fryed curnels
with outen let. <<26>> capons in cassolyce. Take capons and schalde and pyke hom en; e skyn ou opon,
as i e kenne, be hynde o hede, blaw hym with penne; enne ryses o skyn before, rayse up o skyn alle
hole abowte, take porke and hen flesshe with outen doute, and 3 olkes of eyren and gode powder; of
alle o thynges ou make farsure, and farse o skyn and perboyle hit wele; en larde o capone, rost hym
yche dele; of almonde mylke and amydone make bater, and coloure hit anone with safron; serve hit at
fyre rostande, enbene hit wele withe y ry 3 t honde. For to make momene. Take whyte wyne, i telle e,
and sugur erto ry 3 t grete plent ; take, bray o brawne of a 3 t capon; to a pot of oyle of on
galon, and of hony a qwharte ou take; do hit er to as ever ou wake, take powder o mountenaunce of a
pownde, and galingale ginger and canel rownde, and cast er to, and styre hit; enne alle in on pot
sethe hit, i kenne. Lange de beof. Take o ox tonge and schalle hit wele, sethe hit, broche hit in
larde yche dele, with cloves of gelofer hit broch ou shalle, en do hit to fyre and rost hit alle;
<<27>> with 3 olkes of eyren enbene hit ay whille at hit rostes, as i e say. En take blode, at is so
lefe, welle hit in fresshe brothe of e befe, bray hit fulle wele in on mortere, do in fayre grece,
at is so clere; fors hit with spicys ry 3 t gode with alle, and sythun, serve hit in to e halle; to
e forsayde tonge is sawce is dy 3 t, here endes oure potage fulle gode ry 3 t. Pro salsamentis. --
to make sawce. Now speke i wylle of sauces sere: how ay ar made, i wylle 3 ow lere, next after
potage ay servyd schalle be, as i have lurned in ys cuntr . Pur verde sawce. Take persole, peletre
an oyns, and grynde, take whyte bred myude by kynde, temper alle up with venegur or wyne, force hit
with powder of peper fyne. Sawce for mawdelardes rosted. Take onyons and hew hom wele, put sum in o
mawdelarde, so have ou cele, and hacke mo onyons, as i e kenne; with o grece of o mawdelarde ou
sethe hom, en take ale, mustarde and hony o, boyle alle togeder or ou more do; for maularde rosted
ys sawce is dy 3 t, and served in sale by gode ry 3 t. <<28>> sawce for vele and venysone. Take
brede and frye hit in grece ou schalle, with brothe of venegur draw 3 e hit withalle, kast powder of
gynger anon er to and peper, and sethe o and messe hit forthe; a sawce hit is for vele and venyson,
iwys. Blaunche sawce for capons. Take blanchid almondis and smal hom grynde, temper hom with verius,
at is hor kynde, powder of gynger, and kast er to, and messe hit forthe, en hase ou do. Sawce best
for capons rostyd. Take lyver of capons and rost hom wele, take annes and grynd hit, as have ou
cele, pare gynger and canel gode er to, a lytel crust of brede ou take also; grynde al ese ynges
wondur smalle, with verius temper hom up ou schalle; with grece of capons boyle hit in sy 3 t and
serve hit forthe fulle wele ou my 3 t. Sawce sirer for mawdelardus. Take brede and blode iboylyd and
grynde, and draw 3 he hit orowghe a clothe by kynde, with venegur gode and sesounabulle, with powder
of gynger, and peper abulle, and grece of mawdelarde; and boyle alle wele, and messe hit forthe syr
at o mele. <<29>> gawncel for e gose. Take garlek and grynde hit wele for y, temper hit with water a
lytel, perdy; put floure er to and also salt, colour hit with safron i wot ou schalt; temper hit up
with cow-mylke o, and sethe hit and serve hit forthe also. Sawce for swannus. Take o offal and o
lyver of o swan, in gode brothe ou sethe hom an; when hit is sothyne, take oute e bonus, smalle hew
o flesshe, syr, for e nonus; make alyoure of crust of brede, of blode of swanne, at so un is lede,
caste powdur of gynger and clawes er to, of peper and wyn ou take also, and salt hit en and sethe
hit wele; cast in y flesshe, hewen yche a dele, and messe hit forthe, as i e kenne, set hit in sale
before goode menne. [sawce] for cranys and herons. The crane is enarmed ful wele i wot with larde of
porke at on bare mot, rostyd and eten with gode gingere, at is o sawce at servis ere; o heroun is
rosted, as have i blys, and eton with gynger as his kynde is. [sawce] for pekokys and pertrikis.
Pekokys and pertrikys perboylyd schyn be, lardyd, rostyd, eton, levys me, <<30>> with gyngere,
payndmayn paryd clene and groundyn in a morter, at is schene, temperid up with venegur gode, with
powder of gyngere and salt, by o rode, and draw 3 en orowghe a streynour mylde, servid forthe with
pekok and pertrik wylde. Galentyne. Take crust of brede and grynde hit smalle, take powder of
galingale and temper with alle powder of gyngere and salt also; temper hit with venegur er ou more
do, draw 3 e hit urughe a streynour enne, and messe hit forthe before gode menne. Sawce camelyne,
kervelettes and o er thyngus. Take raysons of corouns and kyrnels smalle of notes, and do away o
schale, take crust of brede and clowe in fere, and powder imaked of gode gyngere, flowre of canel ou
schalle take, enne bray alle togedur, as i e kenne, in a morter and salt erto; temper alle with
venegur, en hase ou do, and messe hit forthe; is is sawce fyne, at men calles camelyne. For
lumbardus mustard. Take mustarde and let hit drye anonyn, sir, wyturlye; stomper hit in a morter
fyne, and fars hit urghe a clothe of lyne; do wyne erto and venegur gode, sture hom wele togeder for
e rode, <<31>> and make hit yke inowghe enne, whenne ou hit spendes byfore gode menne, and make hit
thynne with wyne, i say, with diverse metes ou serve hit may. For pykulle. Take droppyng of capone
rostyd wele with wyne and mustarde, as have ou cele, with onyons smalle schrad and sothun in grece,
meng alle in fere and forthe hit messe. Filetus in galentine. Take filetes of porke and half hom
rost, smyte hom in peses with outene bost; draw 3 e a lyoure of blode and brede withalle, do venegur
er to, i wot ou schalle; fors hit with powder of canel, or gode gynger, sethe hit with o flesshe,
alle in fere; salt and messe forthe, enne set hit in sale before gode menne. Pigges in sawce. Take
pigges and scalde hom in water clene, sethe hom in water and salt bydene; take hom up and lete hom
kele; take persoley and sage, and grynde hit wele with e brothe of pigges with owtene rewarde, and 3
olkes of eggus at so un ar harde, temper alle with venegur sumdele stondande; lay pigges in a
vessayle, with bothe hande, held y sawce a-bofe tolde [cold_ms.] for y, and serve hit alle forthe,
syr, wyturly. <<32>> sawce madame. Take sawge, persoly, ysope, saveray, onyons gode, peres, garlek,
i say, and grapes; go fille y gose enne and sew y hole, no grece oute renne; lay hur to fyre and
rost hyr browne, and kepe o grece at falles doune. Take galingale and o grece at renne, do hit in
posnet, as i e kenne; whenne o gose is rostyd, take hir away, smyte hir in pesys, i e pray; at is
within, ou schalle take oute, kest in y posnet with outene doute; 3 if hit is thyke do erto wyne,
and powder of galingale at is fyne, and powder dowce and salt also; boyle alle togeder er ou fyr go,
in a dysshe y gose ou close e sawce abofe, as i suppose. Gose in a hogge pot. In pesis ou schalle y
gose stryke, take water and wyne bothe ilyke; do in y gose; and onyons ou take a gode quantit , as i
er spake, and erbus hacked ou take also, and cast ou in er ou more do; en set y pot over o fyre, and
hit wele stir for e hyre; and make a lyoure of brede and blode, and lye hit erwithe, for hit is
gode; kast powder erto and salt anon, and messe hit, enne ou hase done. <<33>> to save venysone
fresshe over e 3 er. Yf ou wylle kepe e tayle of a dere fresshe in seson over o 3 ere, or o er
venesone yf at hit nede, us schalt u do, i wot in dede; presse out o blode, for anythyng at is cause
for grete rotyng; in er yne pot ou shalt hit pyt and feyre hony do into hit; to o hony stonde over o
flesshe too fyngurs thyke for harde or nesshe; with leder o mouthe en schalt ou bynde, kepe hit fro
ayre, son or wynde, in cofer, or huche or seler merke. For to save venysone fro restyng. Take
venesone when hit is new slayn, and cover hit alle with ferne playn at no wynde enter er to; and
whenne ou hast covered hit so, lede hit home, selor hit lay at wynde ne sone ne ughe hit may; dresse
hit wele and wassh hit clene, sythen, lay hit in water alle by dene, er in be half a day to lye;
enne take hit oute on flore to drye, enne after take salt a quantit ; boyle hit in clene water so
fre, and kele hit, at he be bot lue, and erin wasshe y venesone true, and let hit lye erin thre
dayes and thre ny 3 htes, by any kyns wayes; then take hit oute of at water, salt hit wyth drye
salt, alle in fere. <<34>> and do hit in a barel enne; e barel staf ful as i e kenne, stop wele o
hede for wynde and sone, for hit wylle payre o venysone. To keep herb 3 over e wyntur. Take floure
and rere o cofyns fyne, wele stondande withouten stine; take tenderons of sauge with owte lesyng,
and stop one fulle up to o ryng; enne close o lyd fayre and wele, at ayre go not oute never a dele,
do so with saveray, percil and rewe; and enne bake hom harde, wel ne 3 e brende; sythun, kepe hom
drye and to hom tent; is powder schalle be of more vertu, en opone er e when hit gru. For lyoure
best. Take drye floure, in cofyne hit close, and bake hit hard, as i suppose; ou may hit kepe alle
ys fyve 3 ere, ere-with alye mony metes sere; here endys oure sawce, at i foretolde. De cibis
assatis. Of rostyd mete now speke i wolde, for er bene bestes at schyne be rost, as conyng, pigges,
ful wele ou wost, and foules also at rostyd schyne be on diverse manere in her degr ; and kostyf of
motone, at i wele knaw, enbrochyd shal be, by ry 3 t gode law; <<35>> and also fysshe ou schalle
enbroche, as porpays at swymmes by o see roche; erfore i telle 3 ou now, i rede, what schalle rost
with neck and hede. For e crane. O crane schalle fyrst enarmed be, scalde and pulde ful warl , dra 3
un at o syde as wodcockis, with legges al hole he rostyd is; abowte o brothe o necke ou cralle, put
in o bylle at coler ou schalle; enarme hym forthe as hit is tolde before, and serve ys crane bolde.
For heroun rostyd. E heroun is slayn, as have i sene; e herte oute pyke alle bydene, under e lyft
wyng o neck bone steke, devoyded, as men me tolde meke; enne under o wynge o skyn ou cralle, pyt in
o bylle at coler ou schalle. For wodcock, sny 3 t and curlue. To wodcok, snype, curlue also, e
betore in fere with hom schalle goo; alle schun be dra 3 un, syr, at o syde, and honestly rostyd
with outene pryde, with neck and hede suande in fere, o bylle put urghe o e 3 es sere; on alle ese
fowles o legges schune bene, summe cralled, sum stre 3 t, as i have sene. And gret as heroun rostyd
schalle be, at a kny 3 t is called for gentlor , <<36>> a capone also at comyn is, o pecok wyth his
tayle so have i blys, o fesaunt kok, but not o henne; us have i lurnet at gentil men; alle o er
foles at swymmen in flode, at schun be rostyd, syr, by o rode, with outen necke or hede, i trowe,
and o er smalle bryddes, at i wele knaw, as osel, smityng, laveroc gray, pertryk, werkock, i dayr
wele say; o kormorount schalle rost iwys, with o bylle opone for grete koyntes. For pygges farsyd.
Take swongen eyrene and floure er to, and powder of peper er ou more do; blend alle togeder and salt
erwith; coloure hit with safrone, so have ou blythe; put alle in body of o pygge, rost hit on broche
of irne bygge enfarsed; o cle of pygge schalle be festened in e cheke so mot ou e; o hender legges
enoynt ou schalle, o cles by o sydes ou festun withalle. For fraunche mele. Take swongene eyrene in
bassyne clene, and kreme of mylke at is so schene, and myyd bred, ou put er to, and powder of peper
er ou more do; coloure hit with safrone in hast, and kremelyd sewet of schepe on last, and fylle y
bagge at is so gode, and sew hit fast, syr, for o rode; <<37>> whenne hit is so un, ou schalt hit
leche, and broyle hyt on gredel, as i e teche. For bours. Take porke and gese, hew hom ou schalle on
gobetes, with powder of peper withalle; hom sethe in pot at is so clene, with oute any water, with
salt, i wene; fro martyn messe to gode tyde evyne, ys mete wylle serve, ou may me lene, at dyner or
soper, if at hit nede; ou take gode ale, at is not quede, er in ou boyle o forsayde mete o more
worship ou may gete. For powme dorrys. Take porke and grynde hit rawe, i kenne, temper hit with
swongen egges; enne kast powder to make hit on a balle; in playand water ou kast hit schalle to
harden, enne up ou take, enbroche hit fayre for goddes sake. Endore hit with 3 olkes of egges en
with a fedyr at fyre, as i e kenne; bothe grene and rede ow may hit make with iuse of herb 3 i
undertake; halde under a dysshe at no 3 t be lost, more honest hit is as ou wele wost. Hasteletes on
fysshe day. Take fyggus quartle, and raysyns, o hole dates, almondes, rine hom also on broche of
irne, and rost hom sone; endore hom with 3 olkes of egges anone. <<38>> here endys oure hastere at i
of spake; to speke of bakun mete i wolde clake, for lamprays, darials and flaunes also, and o er
metes mony and moo. For lamprays bakun. Fyrst scalde y lamprays fayre and wele, as i tolde byfore,
so have ou cele; so un, rere a cofyne of flowre so fre, rolle in o lampray, as hit may be; take
mynsud onyons er to, gode wonne, but fyrst take powder of peper, anon of maces, cloves and graynys
also, and dates al hole ou take erto, poure rede wyne erto ou schalle, coloure hit with safrone and
closen alle. In myddes o lydde an tuel ou make, set hit in o ovyn for to bake; 3 ete take hit oute,
fede hit with wyne, lay on o tuel a past fulle fyne, and bake hit forthe, as i e kenne, to serve in
sale before gode menne. For darials. Take creme of almonde mylke iwys, and 3 olkes of eyren, so have
ou blys, and make a batere at is ful gode, and rere a cofyne with mylde mode; and sethe a
mawdelarde, at fat is enne, and cut in peses, as i e kenne; square as dises ou shalt hit make, kast
hit in batere, and powder ou take of gynger, of kanel, at gode is, o enfors hit wele er ou more do,
<<39>> and loke y cofyne be hardened wele, powre in y batere, so have ou cele, with a disshe hit
florysshe ou may, with blanchyd almondes, as i e say. For flaunes. Take new chese and grynde hit
fayre, in morter with egges, with out dysware; put powder er to of sugur, i say, coloure hit with
safrone ful wele ou may; put hit in cofyns at bene fayre, and bake hit forthe, i e pray. For
custanes. Grynde porke, brek eyren er to anon, with powder of peper er ou more done; put hit in
cofyn, at harde is bake, and 3 olke of egge en shalt ou take, that harde is so un, lay in to o top
as hit were a gyldene knop. For risshens. Take grounden porke at so un hase bene with peper and
swongen egges clene; put berme er to, i undertake, as tome as belle hit wille hit make; lay hit in a
roller as sparlyng fysshe, frye hit in grece, lay hit in dysshe. For freture. With egges and floure
in batere ou make, put berme er to, i undertake; <<40>> coloure hit with safrone er ou more do; take
powder of peper and cast er to, kerve appuls overtwert and cast erin, frye hom in grece, no more ne
mynne. Crustate of flesshe. Take peiuns and smalle chekuns with alle and o er smale bryddes, and hew
hom smalle; and sethe hom alle togedur oo in brothe and in white grece, also in verius, and do er to
safroune; fyrst make a fole trap ou mun, pynche hym, cowche hym y flesshe erby; kast erin raysyns of
corouns forthy, and powder dowce and salt gode won; breke eyren and streyne hom thorowghe a clothe
anone, and swyng y sewe erwyth enne, and helde hit onne e flesshe i kenne, and kover y trap and hele

<<41>> tartlotes. Take porke sothun, and grynde hit wele with safroune, and medel hit ylkadel with

dere, and bake hit forthe, as i e kenne, and set in sale before gode menne. Chewetes on fysshe day.

Take flour of ryse, as whyte as sylke, and hit welle, with almond mylke; boyle hit tyl hit be

cast ou in er ou more do; en set y pot over o fyre, and hit wele stir for e hyre; and make a lyoure

hit, enne ou hase done. <<33>> to save venysone fresshe over e 3 er. Yf ou wylle kepe e tayle of a
dere fresshe in seson over o 3 ere, or o er venesone yf at hit nede, us schalt u do, i wot in dede;
presse out o blode, for anythyng at is cause for grete rotyng; in er yne pot ou shalt hit pyt and
feyre hony do into hit; to o hony stonde over o flesshe too fyngurs thyke for harde or nesshe; with
leder o mouthe en schalt ou bynde, kepe hit fro ayre, son or wynde, in cofer, or huche or seler
merke. For to save venysone fro restyng. Take venesone when hit is new slayn, and cover hit alle
with ferne playn at no wynde enter er to; and whenne ou hast covered hit so, lede hit home, selor
hit lay at wynde ne sone ne ughe hit may; dresse hit wele and wassh hit clene, sythen, lay hit in
water alle by dene, er in be half a day to lye; enne take hit oute on flore to drye, enne after take
salt a quantit ; boyle hit in clene water so fre, and kele hit, at he be bot lue, and erin wasshe y
venesone true, and let hit lye erin thre dayes and thre ny 3 htes, by any kyns wayes; then take hit
oute of at water, salt hit wyth drye salt, alle in fere. <<34>> and do hit in a barel enne; e barel
staf ful as i e kenne, stop wele o hede for wynde and sone, for hit wylle payre o venysone. To keep
herb 3 over e wyntur. Take floure and rere o cofyns fyne, wele stondande withouten stine; take
tenderons of sauge with owte lesyng, and stop one fulle up to o ryng; enne close o lyd fayre and
wele, at ayre go not oute never a dele, do so with saveray, percil and rewe; and enne bake hom
harde, wel ne 3 e brende; sythun, kepe hom drye and to hom tent; is powder schalle be of more vertu,
en opone er e when hit gru. For lyoure best. Take drye floure, in cofyne hit close, and bake hit
hard, as i suppose; ou may hit kepe alle ys fyve 3 ere, ere-with alye mony metes sere; here endys
oure sawce, at i foretolde. De cibis assatis. Of rostyd mete now speke i wolde, for er bene bestes
at schyne be rost, as conyng, pigges, ful wele ou wost, and foules also at rostyd schyne be on
diverse manere in her degr ; and kostyf of motone, at i wele knaw, enbrochyd shal be, by ry 3 t gode
law; <<35>> and also fysshe ou schalle enbroche, as porpays at swymmes by o see roche; erfore i
telle 3 ou now, i rede, what schalle rost with neck and hede. For e crane. O crane schalle fyrst
enarmed be, scalde and pulde ful warl , dra 3 un at o syde as wodcockis, with legges al hole he
rostyd is; abowte o brothe o necke ou cralle, put in o bylle at coler ou schalle; enarme hym forthe
as hit is tolde before, and serve ys crane bolde. For heroun rostyd. E heroun is slayn, as have i
sene; e herte oute pyke alle bydene, under e lyft wyng o neck bone steke, devoyded, as men me tolde
meke; enne under o wynge o skyn ou cralle, pyt in o bylle at coler ou schalle. For wodcock, sny 3 t
and curlue. To wodcok, snype, curlue also, e betore in fere with hom schalle goo; alle schun be dra
3 un, syr, at o syde, and honestly rostyd with outene pryde, with neck and hede suande in fere, o
bylle put urghe o e 3 es sere; on alle ese fowles o legges schune bene, summe cralled, sum stre 3 t,
as i have sene. And gret as heroun rostyd schalle be, at a kny 3 t is called for gentlor , <<36>> a
capone also at comyn is, o pecok wyth his tayle so have i blys, o fesaunt kok, but not o henne; us
have i lurnet at gentil men; alle o er foles at swymmen in flode, at schun be rostyd, syr, by o
rode, with outen necke or hede, i trowe, and o er smalle bryddes, at i wele knaw, as osel, smityng,
laveroc gray, pertryk, werkock, i dayr wele say; o kormorount schalle rost iwys, with o bylle opone
for grete koyntes. For pygges farsyd. Take swongen eyrene and floure er to, and powder of peper er
ou more do; blend alle togeder and salt erwith; coloure hit with safrone, so have ou blythe; put

for o rode; <<37>> whenne hit is so un, ou schalt hit leche, and broyle hyt on gredel, as i e teche.
For bours. Take porke and gese, hew hom ou schalle on gobetes, with powder of peper withalle; hom
sethe in pot at is so clene, with oute any water, with salt, i wene; fro martyn messe to gode tyde
evyne, ys mete wylle serve, ou may me lene, at dyner or soper, if at hit nede; ou take gode ale, at
is not quede, er in ou boyle o forsayde mete o more worship ou may gete. For powme dorrys. Take

rede ow may hit make with iuse of herb 3 i undertake; halde under a dysshe at no 3 t be lost, more
honest hit is as ou wele wost. Hasteletes on fysshe day. Take fyggus quartle, and raysyns, o hole

egges anone. <<38>> here endys oure hastere at i of spake; to speke of bakun mete i wolde clake, for
lamprays, darials and flaunes also, and o er metes mony and moo. For lamprays bakun. Fyrst scalde y
lamprays fayre and wele, as i tolde byfore, so have ou cele; so un, rere a cofyne of flowre so fre,
rolle in o lampray, as hit may be; take mynsud onyons er to, gode wonne, but fyrst take powder of
peper, anon of maces, cloves and graynys also, and dates al hole ou take erto, poure rede wyne erto

bake hit forthe, as i e kenne, to serve in sale before gode menne. For darials. Take creme of

kanel, at gode is, o enfors hit wele er ou more do, <<39>> and loke y cofyne be hardened wele, powre
in y batere, so have ou cele, with a disshe hit florysshe ou may, with blanchyd almondes, as i e
say. For flaunes. Take new chese and grynde hit fayre, in morter with egges, with out dysware; put
powder er to of sugur, i say, coloure hit with safrone ful wele ou may; put hit in cofyns at bene
fayre, and bake hit forthe, i e pray. For custanes. Grynde porke, brek eyren er to anon, with powder
of peper er ou more done; put hit in cofyn, at harde is bake, and 3 olke of egge en shalt ou take,
that harde is so un, lay in to o top as hit were a gyldene knop. For risshens. Take grounden porke
at so un hase bene with peper and swongen egges clene; put berme er to, i undertake, as tome as
belle hit wille hit make; lay hit in a roller as sparlyng fysshe, frye hit in grece, lay hit in
dysshe. For freture. With egges and floure in batere ou make, put berme er to, i undertake; <<40>>
coloure hit with safrone er ou more do; take powder of peper and cast er to, kerve appuls overtwert
and cast erin, frye hom in grece, no more ne mynne. Crustate of flesshe. Take peiuns and smalle
chekuns with alle and o er smale bryddes, and hew hom smalle; and sethe hom alle togedur oo in
brothe and in white grece, also in verius, and do er to safroune; fyrst make a fole trap ou mun,
pynche hym, cowche hym y flesshe erby; kast erin raysyns of corouns forthy, and powder dowce and
salt gode won; breke eyren and streyne hom thorowghe a clothe anone, and swyng y sewe erwyth enne,
and helde hit onne e flesshe i kenne, and kover y trap and hele hit wele, and serve hit forthe, syr,
at e mele. Loysyns. In erthen pot put brothe for hast; take floure of payndemayn, and make y past
with water, er of y fele ou make with a roller, and drye hit, i undurtake a 3 ayne o sonne at hit be
harde; kast erin brothe and make rewarde; to sethe hom take rawe chese anone and grate hit in
disshes mony on with powder dowce; and lay er in y loseyns abofe e chese with wynne, and powder on
last spryngil hit ou may; ose loysyns er harde to make in fay. <<41>> tartlotes. Take porke sothun,
and grynde hit wele with safroune, and medel hit ylkadel with egges and raysyns of corouns; o take
powder and salt, and do erto; make a fole of doghe, and close is fast, this flesshe at hewene was
open o last kover hit with lyddes, and pynche hit fayre, korven in e myddes two loyseyns a payr, set
hit with fryed almondes sere, and coloure e past with safroune dere, and bake hit forthe, as i e
kenne, and set in sale before gode menne. Chewetes on fysshe day. Take turbut, haddok, and gode

Take eyren and swete mylke of a cow, swyng hom togedur, as i byd now; take larde of fresshe porke

and sugur erinne, but loke at hit be not to yn, but stondand and saltid mesurl and kepe y dysshe
mete for o maystr . Peions istued. Take peions and hew hom in morselle smalle, put hom in a er yn
pot, ou shalle; take pilled garlek and herbys anon, hack hom smalle er ou more don; put hom in o
pot, and er to take gode brothe with wyte grece, ou no 3 t forsake; do powdur er to and gode verius,
coloure hit with safron, and salt inow; ou put in pote ese ynges alle, and stue y peions us ou
schalle. Sowpus dorre. Take almondes, bray hem, wryng hom up; boyle hom with wyn rede to sup; en
temper hom with wyn, salt, i rede, and loke ou tost fyne wete brede, and lay in dysshes, dubene with
wyne; do in is dysshes mete, at is so fyne; messe hit forthe, and florysshe hit enne with sugur and
gynger, as i e kenne. Gruel of almondes. Take almondes unblanchid and bray hom sone, put ote mele
to, enne hase ou done, and grynde alle sammen, and draw hit enne with water and sethe, as i e kenne;
<<15>> coloure hit with safron and salt hit enne, and set in sale byfore gode menne. Ioutus de

in clothe ou henge hit a myle way, and after in colde water ou hit lay; serve hit forthe in e
dysshe, at day o lorde is servyd with fysshe. <<16>> ryse. Take ryse and wasshe and grynde hem
smalle, temper hom with almonde mylke ou schalle; drau 3 e hom thorowghe a streynour clene, boyle
hom and seson hom with sugur schene; fors hit with fryude almondes gode, en hase ou done, syr, by o

wele; temper hom up with wyne so clene, and drau 3 e hom orowgh a canvas shene; in pot ou coloure

at be; seson hit with sugur grete plent , florysshe hit with maces, i tel e. For to make a rape.
Take raysyns of corauns erto, and wyte wynne ou take also; sethe enne o er raysyns grete in rede

made, i wylle 3 ow lere, next after potage ay servyd schalle be, as i have lurned in ys cuntr . Pur
verde sawce. Take persole, peletre an oyns, and grynde, take whyte bred myude by kynde, temper alle
up with venegur or wyne, force hit with powder of peper fyne. Sawce for mawdelardes rosted. Take
onyons and hew hom wele, put sum in o mawdelarde, so have ou cele, and hacke mo onyons, as i e
kenne; with o grece of o mawdelarde ou sethe hom, en take ale, mustarde and hony o, boyle alle

<<28>> sawce for vele and venysone. Take brede and frye hit in grece ou schalle, with brothe of
venegur draw 3 e hit withalle, kast powder of gynger anon er to and peper, and sethe o and messe hit

and smal hom grynde, temper hom with verius, at is hor kynde, powder of gynger, and kast er to, and
messe hit forthe, en hase ou do. Sawce best for capons rostyd. Take lyver of capons and rost hom
wele, take annes and grynd hit, as have ou cele, pare gynger and canel gode er to, a lytel crust of
brede ou take also; grynde al ese ynges wondur smalle, with verius temper hom up ou schalle; with
grece of capons boyle hit in sy 3 t and serve hit forthe fulle wele ou my 3 t. Sawce sirer for
mawdelardus. Take brede and blode iboylyd and grynde, and draw 3 he hit orowghe a clothe by kynde,
with venegur gode and sesounabulle, with powder of gynger, and peper abulle, and grece of
mawdelarde; and boyle alle wele, and messe hit forthe syr at o mele. <<29>> gawncel for e gose. Take
garlek and grynde hit wele for y, temper hit with water a lytel, perdy; put floure er to and also
salt, colour hit with safron i wot ou schalt; temper hit up with cow-mylke o, and sethe hit and
serve hit forthe also. Sawce for swannus. Take o offal and o lyver of o swan, in gode brothe ou
sethe hom an; when hit is sothyne, take oute e bonus, smalle hew o flesshe, syr, for e nonus; make

cranys and herons. The crane is enarmed ful wele i wot with larde of porke at on bare mot, rostyd
and eten with gode gingere, at is o sawce at servis ere; o heroun is rosted, as have i blys, and
eton with gynger as his kynde is. [sawce] for pekokys and pertrikis. Pekokys and pertrikys perboylyd
schyn be, lardyd, rostyd, eton, levys me, <<30>> with gyngere, payndmayn paryd clene and groundyn in
a morter, at is schene, temperid up with venegur gode, with powder of gyngere and salt, by o rode,
and draw 3 en orowghe a streynour mylde, servid forthe with pekok and pertrik wylde. Galentyne. Take
crust of brede and grynde hit smalle, take powder of galingale and temper with alle powder of
gyngere and salt also; temper hit with venegur er ou more do, draw 3 e hit urughe a streynour enne,
and messe hit forthe before gode menne. Sawce camelyne, kervelettes and o er thyngus. Take raysons
of corouns and kyrnels smalle of notes, and do away o schale, take crust of brede and clowe in fere,
and powder imaked of gode gyngere, flowre of canel ou schalle take, enne bray alle togedur, as i e
kenne, in a morter and salt erto; temper alle with venegur, en hase ou do, and messe hit forthe; is
is sawce fyne, at men calles camelyne. For lumbardus mustard. Take mustarde and let hit drye anonyn,
sir, wyturlye; stomper hit in a morter fyne, and fars hit urghe a clothe of lyne; do wyne erto and
venegur gode, sture hom wele togeder for e rode, <<31>> and make hit yke inowghe enne, whenne ou hit
spendes byfore gode menne, and make hit thynne with wyne, i say, with diverse metes ou serve hit
may. For pykulle. Take droppyng of capone rostyd wele with wyne and mustarde, as have ou cele, with

canel, or gode gynger, sethe hit with o flesshe, alle in fere; salt and messe forthe, enne set hit
in sale before gode menne. Pigges in sawce. Take pigges and scalde hom in water clene, sethe hom in

with e brothe of pigges with owtene rewarde, and 3 olkes of eggus at so un ar harde, temper alle
with venegur sumdele stondande; lay pigges in a vessayle, with bothe hande, held y sawce a-bofe
tolde [cold_ms.] for y, and serve hit alle forthe, syr, wyturly. <<32>> sawce madame. Take sawge,
persoly, ysope, saveray, onyons gode, peres, garlek, i say, and grapes; go fille y gose enne and sew
y hole, no grece oute renne; lay hur to fyre and rost hyr browne, and kepe o grece at falles doune.
Take galingale and o grece at renne, do hit in posnet, as i e kenne; whenne o gose is rostyd, take
hir away, smyte hir in pesys, i e pray; at is within, ou schalle take oute, kest in y posnet with

in y gose; and onyons ou take a gode quantit , as i er spake, and erbus hacked ou take also, and
cast ou in er ou more do; en set y pot over o fyre, and hit wele stir for e hyre; and make a lyoure
of brede and blode, and lye hit erwithe, for hit is gode; kast powder erto and salt anon, and messe
hit, enne ou hase done. <<33>> to save venysone fresshe over e 3 er. Yf ou wylle kepe e tayle of a
dere fresshe in seson over o 3 ere, or o er venesone yf at hit nede, us schalt u do, i wot in dede;
presse out o blode, for anythyng at is cause for grete rotyng; in er yne pot ou shalt hit pyt and
feyre hony do into hit; to o hony stonde over o flesshe too fyngurs thyke for harde or nesshe; with
leder o mouthe en schalt ou bynde, kepe hit fro ayre, son or wynde, in cofer, or huche or seler
merke. For to save venysone fro restyng. Take venesone when hit is new slayn, and cover hit alle
with ferne playn at no wynde enter er to; and whenne ou hast covered hit so, lede hit home, selor
hit lay at wynde ne sone ne ughe hit may; dresse hit wele and wassh hit clene, sythen, lay hit in
water alle by dene, er in be half a day to lye; enne take hit oute on flore to drye, enne after take
salt a quantit ; boyle hit in clene water so fre, and kele hit, at he be bot lue, and erin wasshe y
venesone true, and let hit lye erin thre dayes and thre ny 3 htes, by any kyns wayes; then take hit
oute of at water, salt hit wyth drye salt, alle in fere. <<34>> and do hit in a barel enne; e barel
staf ful as i e kenne, stop wele o hede for wynde and sone, for hit wylle payre o venysone. To keep
herb 3 over e wyntur. Take floure and rere o cofyns fyne, wele stondande withouten stine; take
tenderons of sauge with owte lesyng, and stop one fulle up to o ryng; enne close o lyd fayre and
wele, at ayre go not oute never a dele, do so with saveray, percil and rewe; and enne bake hom
harde, wel ne 3 e brende; sythun, kepe hom drye and to hom tent; is powder schalle be of more vertu,
en opone er e when hit gru. For lyoure best. Take drye floure, in cofyne hit close, and bake hit
hard, as i suppose; ou may hit kepe alle ys fyve 3 ere, ere-with alye mony metes sere; here endys
oure sawce, at i foretolde. De cibis assatis. Of rostyd mete now speke i wolde, for er bene bestes
at schyne be rost, as conyng, pigges, ful wele ou wost, and foules also at rostyd schyne be on
diverse manere in her degr ; and kostyf of motone, at i wele knaw, enbrochyd shal be, by ry 3 t gode

enarmed be, scalde and pulde ful warl , dra 3 un at o syde as wodcockis, with legges al hole he
rostyd is; abowte o brothe o necke ou cralle, put in o bylle at coler ou schalle; enarme hym forthe
as hit is tolde before, and serve ys crane bolde. For heroun rostyd. E heroun is slayn, as have i
sene; e herte oute pyke alle bydene, under e lyft wyng o neck bone steke, devoyded, as men me tolde
meke; enne under o wynge o skyn ou cralle, pyt in o bylle at coler ou schalle. For wodcock, sny 3 t
and curlue. To wodcok, snype, curlue also, e betore in fere with hom schalle goo; alle schun be dra

rede ow may hit make with iuse of herb 3 i undertake; halde under a dysshe at no 3 t be lost, more

egges anone. <<38>> here endys oure hastere at i of spake; to speke of bakun mete i wolde clake, for
lamprays, darials and flaunes also, and o er metes mony and moo. For lamprays bakun. Fyrst scalde y
lamprays fayre and wele, as i tolde byfore, so have ou cele; so un, rere a cofyne of flowre so fre,
rolle in o lampray, as hit may be; take mynsud onyons er to, gode wonne, but fyrst take powder of
peper, anon of maces, cloves and graynys also, and dates al hole ou take erto, poure rede wyne erto

bake hit forthe, as i e kenne, to serve in sale before gode menne. For darials. Take creme of
almonde mylke iwys, and 3 olkes of eyren, so have ou blys, and make a batere at is ful gode, and

say. For flaunes. Take new chese and grynde hit fayre, in morter with egges, with out dysware; put
powder er to of sugur, i say, coloure hit with safrone ful wele ou may; put hit in cofyns at bene

of peper er ou more done; put hit in cofyn, at harde is bake, and 3 olke of egge en shalt ou take,
that harde is so un, lay in to o top as hit were a gyldene knop. For risshens. Take grounden porke
at so un hase bene with peper and swongen egges clene; put berme er to, i undertake, as tome as

dysshe. For freture. With egges and floure in batere ou make, put berme er to, i undertake; <<40>>
coloure hit with safrone er ou more do; take powder of peper and cast er to, kerve appuls overtwert
and cast erin, frye hom in grece, no more ne mynne. Crustate of flesshe. Take peiuns and smalle

brothe and in white grece, also in verius, and do er to safroune; fyrst make a fole trap ou mun,

last spryngil hit ou may; ose loysyns er harde to make in fay. <<41>> tartlotes. Take porke sothun,

kenne, and set in sale before gode menne. Chewetes on fysshe day. Take turbut, haddok, and gode

Sethe hennes and porke, at is fulle fresshe; bray almondes unblanchyd and temper hom nesshe with

rede to sup; en temper hom with wyn, salt, i rede, and loke ou tost fyne wete brede, and lay in

sone, put ote mele to, enne hase ou done, and grynde alle sammen, and draw hit enne with water and
sethe, as i e kenne; <<15>> coloure hit with safron and salt hit enne, and set in sale byfore gode

Buttur of almonde mylke. Take thykke mylke of almondes clere, boyle wele alle in fere; and in o
boylyng, cast erinne venegur, o er ellys gode wyne; do hit so enne in a canvas enne, in so un, gar
hit on hepe to renne; in clothe ou henge hit a myle way, and after in colde water ou hit lay; serve

grynde hem smalle, temper hom with almonde mylke ou schalle; drau 3 e hom thorowghe a streynour
clene, boyle hom and seson hom with sugur schene; fors hit with fryude almondes gode, en hase ou

thykke loke ou at be; seson hit with sugur grete plent , florysshe hit with maces, i tel e. For to
make a rape. Take raysyns of corauns erto, and wyte wynne ou take also; sethe enne o er raysyns
grete in rede wyne, and boyle a lytul with hete; do opon a broche, rost hom bydene a lytel, and take

e pot with grythe, o raysyns of corauns, o swete wyne with, a lytul vengur, and pouder take o of
clowes, maces and quibibis to; <<17>> boyle alle to geder, and serve hit enne, and sett hit forthe
before goode men. Mylke rostyd. Take swete mylke and put in panne, swyng eyren with alle, grynde
safron and do erto; welle hit enne, tylle hit wax thykke, as i e kenne; and sethe and sye hit
thorowghe a cloth, presse hit, at leves, withouten othe; when hit is colde, leche hit with knyves;
rost hit, and messe hit forthe on schyves. For to make a potage of welkes. Take welkes and wasshe

ou may, at a worde, and bray hom in a morter clere; sethe hom in mylke over e fyre; of almondes or

poudur of peper, or goode comyne. For to make potage of oysturs. Perboyle yn oysturs and take hom
oute; kepe welle y bre with outen doute, and hakke hom on a borde full smalle, and bray in a morter
ou schalle; do hom in hor owne brothe for goode, do mylke of almondes er to by e rode, and lye hit
up with amydone, and frye smalle mynsud onyone <<18>> in oyle, or sethe hom in mylke ou schalle; do
powdur erto of spyces withalle, and coloure hit enne with safron gode; hit is holden restoratyf
fode. Sauge seynes. Take swynes fete and sethe hom clene, take 3 olkes of eyren at harde bene, and
sage as mykul as fall erto, gode powdur, and temper with venegur; when ou hase so yn o fete ry 3 t
welle, clovyn hom and paryd hom er tylle, lay hom on dysshe with blythe, o sawce on e 3 olkes
erwyth. For to make a compost. Take o chekyns and hew hom for o seke, all but e hede and e legges
eke; take a handfulle of herb lovache, and ano er of persely, als of sage at never was founde fals,
and no er of lekes and alle hom wasshe ose herbes in water, at rennes so rasshe; breke orowghe y
honde, bothe herbe and leke, with a pynt of hony enbeny hom eke, summe of ese herbes ou shalle laye
in e pottus bothun [sothun?], as i e say; summe of e chekyns ou put erto, and en of e herb 3 do to
also; so of o ton so of at o er, o herb 3 on e last my dere brother; above ese herbus a lytul larde
smalle myncyd, haldand togeder warde; take powder of gynger and canel god wone, cast on ese o er
thynges everychon; <<19>> be sle 3 e and powre in water enne to myd o pot, as i the kenne; opone o
bruys poure hit withinne, and cover hit at no hete oute wynne, and tendurly seyth hit ou do may,
salt hit, serve hit, as i e say. Blanc maungere of fysshe. Take a pownde of ryse and sethe hom wele,
tyl at ay brostene; and lete hom kele. Mylke of almondes erto ou cast, o tenche or lampray do to on
last; welle alle togeder, as i e kenne, and messe hit forthe before godde men. Mortrews of fysshe.
Take o kelkes of fysshe anon, and o lyver of o fysshe, sethe hom alon; en take brede and peper and
ale, and temper o brothe fulle welle ou schalle, and welle hit togeder and serve hit enne, and set
in sale before good mene. For to make rose dalmoyne. Take whyte pese and wasshe hom wele, tylle at
ey hulle, sethe yche adele, and bene clene of am, en schalle ou caste in to o pot and cover in hast;
and loke no brethe er passe oute, but boyle hom wele with owtyn dowte; of almonde mylke ou kest
erto, of floure of ryse and salt also; <<20>> coloure hit with safrone and messe hit, enne set hit
in sale before goode men. For a kolys. E brawne take of sothun henne or chekyne, and hew hit smalle
and bray en with wyne, with ote grotis, and whyte brede eke; with e brothe of henne ou tempur hit
meke; take oute e bonys and grynd hit smalle, in to e brothe ou kast hit alle, and sye hit thurgh a
clothe clene; dose hit, and serve hit forthe bydene. Gruel of porke. Take brawne of swyne, perboyle
hit wele, and grynde hit smalle, syr, everydele; with 3 olkes of eyren ou schalle hit lye, set hit
over e fyre for- ye, put whyte grece erto, bewar, iwys, let hit not sethe lest ou mys. Do er to
powder and safron enne and messe hit forthe before goode menne; powder dowce eron ou kast stondande
at dressore on e last. Conyngus in cyne. [>cyve.] smyte e conyngus in pese smalle; and sethe hom in
brothe gode ou shalle; mynsyn onyons in grece ou sethe, and in good brothe, at is so smethe walle
togeder; and drau 3 e alioure of blode and brede sumdele sowre, <<21>> sesonut with venegur and good
brothe eke, kast salt erto and powder fulle meke. Harus in cyne. [>cyve.] perboyle e hare and larde
hit wele, sethyn loke ou rost hir everydele; take onyons and loke ou hew hom smalle, frye hom in
grece, take peper and ale, and grynde togeder o onyons also; coloure hit with safrone and welle hit
o; lay e hare in charioure, as i e kenne; powre on e sewe and serve hit enne. Harus in a sewe. Alle
rawe o hare schalle hacked be, in gobettis smalle, syr, levys me; in hir owne blode seyn or sylud
clene, grynde brede and peper withalle bydene; enne temper hit with e same bre, enne boyled and
salted hit servyd schalle be. Harus in abrotet. [>harus_in_a_browet.] hew smalle y hare in gobetus
gode, sethe hom in brothe with alle his blode; when hit is so un wondur wele, draw 3 h thurgh a
streynour, so have ou cele; take almondes unblanchid, wasshe hom and grynde; with self brothe temper
hom by kynde; take onyons and perboyle hom ou mot, and dresshe hom smalle, kest hom in pot with alle
o er thyngus, and cast er to with venegur and salt, en hase ou doo. <<22>> harus in perdoylyse. Take
harys and perboyle hom, i rede, in goode brothe, kele hit for drede, and hew y flesshe and cast
erinne. Take swongen eggus, no more ne myn, and cast in y sewe and sethe hit enne. Take obles and
wafrons, as i e kenne, close hom in dysshes fare and wele; salt e sewe, so have ou cele, and lay hit
above as gode men done, and messe hit forthe, syr, at o none. Hennes in brewes. With porke ou sethe
o henne fatte, grynde brede and peper and be not batte; and comyne also ou schalle grynde, seson hom
with ale, at is hor kynde; with o brothe of hennes ou temper hit shalle, boyle hit, coloure hit,
salt hit withalle; serve hom forthe, as ou may see, ese er hennes in browet, levys ou me. Chekyns in
browet. Take chekyns, scalde hom fayre and clene; take persole, sauge, o er herb 3 , grene grapus,
and stope y chekyns with wynne; take goode brothe, sethe hom erinne, so at ay sone boyled may be;
coloure e brothe with safrone fre, and cast eron powder dowce, for to be served in goode mennys
howse. <<23>> chekyns in cawdel. In brothe ou boyle y chekyns gode; take 3 olkes of eyren, syr, for
o rode, alye hom up with brothe forsayde; take powder gynger, abrayde, and sugur, and rew, and
safron clere, and salt, and set hit over o fyre; with owtyn boylyng messe hit forthe enne; y chekyns
hole take, i e kenne, of [yf?_ m ] ay be brokyn, on dysshe hom lay, helde hom e sewe, as i e say.
For to boyle fesawantes and pertryks. Take goode brothe, erin ou pyt y fesauntes and y pertryks, at
men may wyt. Do erto ale, floure, peper fre, of hole canel, good quantit ; and let alle sethe erwyth
fulle wele, and messe hit forthe, syr, at e mele. Powder dowce erin ou cast, when hit [is] servyd on
e last. Roo in a sewe. Take o roo, pyke hit clene forthy; boyle hit ou shalt and after hit drye; hew
hit on gobettis, at ben smalle, do hit in pot withalle; kest wyn erto, if ou do ry 3 t, take persole
and sawge and ysope bry 3 t, wasshe hom and hew hom wondur smalle, and do erto hit ou schalle,
coloure hit with blode or sawnders hors. <<24>> hennes in grav . Take hennes and rost, as i e kenne,
sithinn, hew hom smalle and frye hom; enne take wyne or peper or venegur to, grynd hit togeder with
hennes o; lye hit with 3 olkes of eyren wele, coloure hit with safrone everydele, and messe hit
forthe withoutene ony more, and loke ou for 3 ete no 3 t ys lore. Capons in covisye. Take capons and
sethe hom wele, and hew hom smalle ilkadele; take peper and brede, and grynde hit smalle, and temper
hit up with capon alle; take why 3 te of eyren harde so un o, and hake hom smalle and do erto, and
boyle e capon and coloure hit enne with safrone, and do as i kenne; o 3 olkes of eggus, i telle e,
alle hole ou put in disshe so fre. Hennes in gauncel. Take first and rost welle y henne, take garlek
by hit selfe and grynd; enne blonde hit with mylke and put alle in panne, and hew yn henne and do er
to enne y henne and 3 olkes of eyren imelle; coloure hit with safron and let hit welle, and messe
hit forthe, i telle e; but ou wille alye hit with floure so fre. <<25>> lamprayes in browet. Take
lamprayes and scalde hom by kynde, sythyn, rost hom on gredyl, and grynde peper and safrone; welle
hit with alle, do o lampreyes and serve hit in sale. Lamprayes in galentine. Take lamprayes and hom
let blode at o navel, and scalde hom for gode; rost hom enne, and ou hom laye alle hole in platere,
as i e saye; serve with galentine, made in sale, with gyngere, canel and galingale. For tenchis in
grav . Sethe y tenchis, and after hom brede, and rost hom on a gredel, i rede; grynd peper and
safron with ale, i kenne, with tenchis brothe, ou temper hit; enne lay o tenche opon a platere
fayre, do on at browet withouten disware. Chawdewyne de boyce. Take smalle notes, schale not [out?_
m ] kurnele, as ou dose of almondes, fayre and wele; frye hom in oyle, en sethe hom ry 3 t in
almonde mylke at is bry 3 t; en ou schalle do in floure of ryce and also o er pouder of spyce; fry o
er curneles besyde also, coloure ou hit with safron, or ou fer goo, to divers o mete ou schalt hit
set, with o fryed curnels with outen let. <<26>> capons in cassolyce. Take capons and schalde and
pyke hom en; e skyn ou opon, as i e kenne, be hynde o hede, blaw hym with penne; enne ryses o skyn
before, rayse up o skyn alle hole abowte, take porke and hen flesshe with outen doute, and 3 olkes
of eyren and gode powder; of alle o thynges ou make farsure, and farse o skyn and perboyle hit wele;
en larde o capone, rost hym yche dele; of almonde mylke and amydone make bater, and coloure hit
anone with safron; serve hit at fyre rostande, enbene hit wele withe y ry 3 t honde. For to make
momene. Take whyte wyne, i telle e, and sugur erto ry 3 t grete plent ; take, bray o brawne of a 3 t
capon; to a pot of oyle of on galon, and of hony a qwharte ou take; do hit er to as ever ou wake,
take powder o mountenaunce of a pownde, and galingale ginger and canel rownde, and cast er to, and
styre hit; enne alle in on pot sethe hit, i kenne. Lange de beof. Take o ox tonge and schalle hit
wele, sethe hit, broche hit in larde yche dele, with cloves of gelofer hit broch ou shalle, en do
hit to fyre and rost hit alle; <<27>> with 3 olkes of eyren enbene hit ay whille at hit rostes, as i
e say. En take blode, at is so lefe, welle hit in fresshe brothe of e befe, bray hit fulle wele in
on mortere, do in fayre grece, at is so clere; fors hit with spicys ry 3 t gode with alle, and
sythun, serve hit in to e halle; to e forsayde tonge is sawce is dy 3 t, here endes oure potage
fulle gode ry 3 t. Pro salsamentis. -- to make sawce. Now speke i wylle of sauces sere: how ay ar
made, i wylle 3 ow lere, next after potage ay servyd schalle be, as i have lurned in ys cuntr . Pur
verde sawce. Take persole, peletre an oyns, and grynde, take whyte bred myude by kynde, temper alle
up with venegur or wyne, force hit with powder of peper fyne. Sawce for mawdelardes rosted. Take
onyons and hew hom wele, put sum in o mawdelarde, so have ou cele, and hacke mo onyons, as i e
kenne; with o grece of o mawdelarde ou sethe hom, en take ale, mustarde and hony o, boyle alle
togeder or ou more do; for maularde rosted ys sawce is dy 3 t, and served in sale by gode ry 3 t.
<<28>> sawce for vele and venysone. Take brede and frye hit in grece ou schalle, with brothe of
venegur draw 3 e hit withalle, kast powder of gynger anon er to and peper, and sethe o and messe hit
forthe; a sawce hit is for vele and venyson, iwys. Blaunche sawce for capons. Take blanchid almondis
and smal hom grynde, temper hom with verius, at is hor kynde, powder of gynger, and kast er to, and
messe hit forthe, en hase ou do. Sawce best for capons rostyd. Take lyver of capons and rost hom
wele, take annes and grynd hit, as have ou cele, pare gynger and canel gode er to, a lytel crust of
brede ou take also; grynde al ese ynges wondur smalle, with verius temper hom up ou schalle; with
grece of capons boyle hit in sy 3 t and serve hit forthe fulle wele ou my 3 t. Sawce sirer for
mawdelardus. Take brede and blode iboylyd and grynde, and draw 3 he hit orowghe a clothe by kynde,
with venegur gode and sesounabulle, with powder of gynger, and peper abulle, and grece of
mawdelarde; and boyle alle wele, and messe hit forthe syr at o mele. <<29>> gawncel for e gose. Take
garlek and grynde hit wele for y, temper hit with water a lytel, perdy; put floure er to and also
salt, colour hit with safron i wot ou schalt; temper hit up with cow-mylke o, and sethe hit and
serve hit forthe also. Sawce for swannus. Take o offal and o lyver of o swan, in gode brothe ou
sethe hom an; when hit is sothyne, take oute e bonus, smalle hew o flesshe, syr, for e nonus; make
alyoure of crust of brede, of blode of swanne, at so un is lede, caste powdur of gynger and clawes
er to, of peper and wyn ou take also, and salt hit en and sethe hit wele; cast in y flesshe, hewen
yche a dele, and messe hit forthe, as i e kenne, set hit in sale before goode menne. [sawce] for
cranys and herons. The crane is enarmed ful wele i wot with larde of porke at on bare mot, rostyd
and eten with gode gingere, at is o sawce at servis ere; o heroun is rosted, as have i blys, and
eton with gynger as his kynde is. [sawce] for pekokys and pertrikis. Pekokys and pertrikys perboylyd
schyn be, lardyd, rostyd, eton, levys me, <<30>> with gyngere, payndmayn paryd clene and groundyn in
a morter, at is schene, temperid up with venegur gode, with powder of gyngere and salt, by o rode,
and draw 3 en orowghe a streynour mylde, servid forthe with pekok and pertrik wylde. Galentyne. Take
crust of brede and grynde hit smalle, take powder of galingale and temper with alle powder of
gyngere and salt also; temper hit with venegur er ou more do, draw 3 e hit urughe a streynour enne,
and messe hit forthe before gode menne. Sawce camelyne, kervelettes and o er thyngus. Take raysons
of corouns and kyrnels smalle of notes, and do away o schale, take crust of brede and clowe in fere,
and powder imaked of gode gyngere, flowre of canel ou schalle take, enne bray alle togedur, as i e
kenne, in a morter and salt erto; temper alle with venegur, en hase ou do, and messe hit forthe; is
is sawce fyne, at men calles camelyne. For lumbardus mustard. Take mustarde and let hit drye anonyn,
sir, wyturlye; stomper hit in a morter fyne, and fars hit urghe a clothe of lyne; do wyne erto and
venegur gode, sture hom wele togeder for e rode, <<31>> and make hit yke inowghe enne, whenne ou hit
spendes byfore gode menne, and make hit thynne with wyne, i say, with diverse metes ou serve hit
may. For pykulle. Take droppyng of capone rostyd wele with wyne and mustarde, as have ou cele, with
onyons smalle schrad and sothun in grece, meng alle in fere and forthe hit messe. Filetus in
galentine. Take filetes of porke and half hom rost, smyte hom in peses with outene bost; draw 3 e a
lyoure of blode and brede withalle, do venegur er to, i wot ou schalle; fors hit with powder of
canel, or gode gynger, sethe hit with o flesshe, alle in fere; salt and messe forthe, enne set hit
in sale before gode menne. Pigges in sawce. Take pigges and scalde hom in water clene, sethe hom in
water and salt bydene; take hom up and lete hom kele; take persoley and sage, and grynde hit wele
with e brothe of pigges with owtene rewarde, and 3 olkes of eggus at so un ar harde, temper alle
with venegur sumdele stondande; lay pigges in a vessayle, with bothe hande, held y sawce a-bofe
tolde [cold_ms.] for y, and serve hit alle forthe, syr, wyturly. <<32>> sawce madame. Take sawge,
persoly, ysope, saveray, onyons gode, peres, garlek, i say, and grapes; go fille y gose enne and sew
y hole, no grece oute renne; lay hur to fyre and rost hyr browne, and kepe o grece at falles doune.
Take galingale and o grece at renne, do hit in posnet, as i e kenne; whenne o gose is rostyd, take
hir away, smyte hir in pesys, i e pray; at is within, ou schalle take oute, kest in y posnet with
outene doute; 3 if hit is thyke do erto wyne, and powder of galingale at is fyne, and powder dowce
and salt also; boyle alle togeder er ou fyr go, in a dysshe y gose ou close e sawce abofe, as i
suppose. Gose in a hogge pot. In pesis ou schalle y gose stryke, take water and wyne bothe ilyke; do
in y gose; and onyons ou take a gode quantit , as i er spake, and erbus hacked ou take also, and
cast ou in er ou more do; en set y pot over o fyre, and hit wele stir for e hyre; and make a lyoure
of brede and blode, and lye hit erwithe, for hit is gode; kast powder erto and salt anon, and messe
hit, enne ou hase done. <<33>> to save venysone fresshe over e 3 er. Yf ou wylle kepe e tayle of a
dere fresshe in seson over o 3 ere, or o er venesone yf at hit nede, us schalt u do, i wot in dede;
presse out o blode, for anythyng at is cause for grete rotyng; in er yne pot ou shalt hit pyt and
feyre hony do into hit; to o hony stonde over o flesshe too fyngurs thyke for harde or nesshe; with
leder o mouthe en schalt ou bynde, kepe hit fro ayre, son or wynde, in cofer, or huche or seler
merke. For to save venysone fro restyng. Take venesone when hit is new slayn, and cover hit alle
with ferne playn at no wynde enter er to; and whenne ou hast covered hit so, lede hit home, selor
hit lay at wynde ne sone ne ughe hit may; dresse hit wele and wassh hit clene, sythen, lay hit in
water alle by dene, er in be half a day to lye; enne take hit oute on flore to drye, enne after take
salt a quantit ; boyle hit in clene water so fre, and kele hit, at he be bot lue, and erin wasshe y
venesone true, and let hit lye erin thre dayes and thre ny 3 htes, by any kyns wayes; then take hit
oute of at water, salt hit wyth drye salt, alle in fere. <<34>> and do hit in a barel enne; e barel
staf ful as i e kenne, stop wele o hede for wynde and sone, for hit wylle payre o venysone. To keep
herb 3 over e wyntur. Take floure and rere o cofyns fyne, wele stondande withouten stine; take
tenderons of sauge with owte lesyng, and stop one fulle up to o ryng; enne close o lyd fayre and
wele, at ayre go not oute never a dele, do so with saveray, percil and rewe; and enne bake hom
harde, wel ne 3 e brende; sythun, kepe hom drye and to hom tent; is powder schalle be of more vertu,
en opone er e when hit gru. For lyoure best. Take drye floure, in cofyne hit close, and bake hit
hard, as i suppose; ou may hit kepe alle ys fyve 3 ere, ere-with alye mony metes sere; here endys
oure sawce, at i foretolde. De cibis assatis. Of rostyd mete now speke i wolde, for er bene bestes
at schyne be rost, as conyng, pigges, ful wele ou wost, and foules also at rostyd schyne be on
diverse manere in her degr ; and kostyf of motone, at i wele knaw, enbrochyd shal be, by ry 3 t gode
law; <<35>> and also fysshe ou schalle enbroche, as porpays at swymmes by o see roche; erfore i
telle 3 ou now, i rede, what schalle rost with neck and hede. For e crane. O crane schalle fyrst
enarmed be, scalde and pulde ful warl , dra 3 un at o syde as wodcockis, with legges al hole he
rostyd is; abowte o brothe o necke ou cralle, put in o bylle at coler ou schalle; enarme hym forthe
as hit is tolde before, and serve ys crane bolde. For heroun rostyd. E heroun is slayn, as have i
sene; e herte oute pyke alle bydene, under e lyft wyng o neck bone steke, devoyded, as men me tolde
meke; enne under o wynge o skyn ou cralle, pyt in o bylle at coler ou schalle. For wodcock, sny 3 t
and curlue. To wodcok, snype, curlue also, e betore in fere with hom schalle goo; alle schun be dra
3 un, syr, at o syde, and honestly rostyd with outene pryde, with neck and hede suande in fere, o
bylle put urghe o e 3 es sere; on alle ese fowles o legges schune bene, summe cralled, sum stre 3 t,
as i have sene. And gret as heroun rostyd schalle be, at a kny 3 t is called for gentlor , <<36>> a
capone also at comyn is, o pecok wyth his tayle so have i blys, o fesaunt kok, but not o henne; us
have i lurnet at gentil men; alle o er foles at swymmen in flode, at schun be rostyd, syr, by o
rode, with outen necke or hede, i trowe, and o er smalle bryddes, at i wele knaw, as osel, smityng,
laveroc gray, pertryk, werkock, i dayr wele say; o kormorount schalle rost iwys, with o bylle opone
for grete koyntes. For pygges farsyd. Take swongen eyrene and floure er to, and powder of peper er
ou more do; blend alle togeder and salt erwith; coloure hit with safrone, so have ou blythe; put
alle in body of o pygge, rost hit on broche of irne bygge enfarsed; o cle of pygge schalle be
festened in e cheke so mot ou e; o hender legges enoynt ou schalle, o cles by o sydes ou festun
withalle. For fraunche mele. Take swongene eyrene in bassyne clene, and kreme of mylke at is so
schene, and myyd bred, ou put er to, and powder of peper er ou more do; coloure hit with safrone in
hast, and kremelyd sewet of schepe on last, and fylle y bagge at is so gode, and sew hit fast, syr,
for o rode; <<37>> whenne hit is so un, ou schalt hit leche, and broyle hyt on gredel, as i e teche.
For bours. Take porke and gese, hew hom ou schalle on gobetes, with powder of peper withalle; hom
sethe in pot at is so clene, with oute any water, with salt, i wene; fro martyn messe to gode tyde
evyne, ys mete wylle serve, ou may me lene, at dyner or soper, if at hit nede; ou take gode ale, at
is not quede, er in ou boyle o forsayde mete o more worship ou may gete. For powme dorrys. Take
porke and grynde hit rawe, i kenne, temper hit with swongen egges; enne kast powder to make hit on a
balle; in playand water ou kast hit schalle to harden, enne up ou take, enbroche hit fayre for
goddes sake. Endore hit with 3 olkes of egges en with a fedyr at fyre, as i e kenne; bothe grene and
rede ow may hit make with iuse of herb 3 i undertake; halde under a dysshe at no 3 t be lost, more
honest hit is as ou wele wost. Hasteletes on fysshe day. Take fyggus quartle, and raysyns, o hole
dates, almondes, rine hom also on broche of irne, and rost hom sone; endore hom with 3 olkes of
egges anone. <<38>> here endys oure hastere at i of spake; to speke of bakun mete i wolde clake, for
lamprays, darials and flaunes also, and o er metes mony and moo. For lamprays bakun. Fyrst scalde y
lamprays fayre and wele, as i tolde byfore, so have ou cele; so un, rere a cofyne of flowre so fre,
rolle in o lampray, as hit may be; take mynsud onyons er to, gode wonne, but fyrst take powder of
peper, anon of maces, cloves and graynys also, and dates al hole ou take erto, poure rede wyne erto
ou schalle, coloure hit with safrone and closen alle. In myddes o lydde an tuel ou make, set hit in
o ovyn for to bake; 3 ete take hit oute, fede hit with wyne, lay on o tuel a past fulle fyne, and
bake hit forthe, as i e kenne, to serve in sale before gode menne. For darials. Take creme of
almonde mylke iwys, and 3 olkes of eyren, so have ou blys, and make a batere at is ful gode, and
rere a cofyne with mylde mode; and sethe a mawdelarde, at fat is enne, and cut in peses, as i e
kenne; square as dises ou shalt hit make, kast hit in batere, and powder ou take of gynger, of
kanel, at gode is, o enfors hit wele er ou more do, <<39>> and loke y cofyne be hardened wele, powre
in y batere, so have ou cele, with a disshe hit florysshe ou may, with blanchyd almondes, as i e
say. For flaunes. Take new chese and grynde hit fayre, in morter with egges, with out dysware; put

that harde is so un, lay in to o top as hit were a gyldene knop. For risshens. Take grounden porke

coloure hit with safrone er ou more do; take powder of peper and cast er to, kerve appuls overtwert
and cast erin, frye hom in grece, no more ne mynne. Crustate of flesshe. Take peiuns and smalle
chekuns with alle and o er smale bryddes, and hew hom smalle; and sethe hom alle togedur oo in
brothe and in white grece, also in verius, and do er to safroune; fyrst make a fole trap ou mun,
pynche hym, cowche hym y flesshe erby; kast erin raysyns of corouns forthy, and powder dowce and
salt gode won; breke eyren and streyne hom thorowghe a clothe anone, and swyng y sewe erwyth enne,
and helde hit onne e flesshe i kenne, and kover y trap and hele hit wele, and serve hit forthe, syr,
at e mele. Loysyns. In erthen pot put brothe for hast; take floure of payndemayn, and make y past
with water, er of y fele ou make with a roller, and drye hit, i undurtake a 3 ayne o sonne at hit be
harde; kast erin brothe and make rewarde; to sethe hom take rawe chese anone and grate hit in
disshes mony on with powder dowce; and lay er in y loseyns abofe e chese with wynne, and powder on
last spryngil hit ou may; ose loysyns er harde to make in fay. <<41>> tartlotes. Take porke sothun,
and grynde hit wele with safroune, and medel hit ylkadel with egges and raysyns of corouns; o take

hit with fryed almondes sere, and coloure e past with safroune dere, and bake hit forthe, as i e
kenne, and set in sale before gode menne. Chewetes on fysshe day. Take turbut, haddok, and gode

Take peions and hew hom in morselle smalle, put hom in a er yn pot, ou shalle; take pilled garlek

For to make a potage of welkes. Take welkes and wasshe fayre, in blythe, in water, and take whyte
